description.zh: 是否启用录屏配置：如果设置为true，实例对应配置存在则更新，不存在则新建；如果设置为false，关闭对应实例录屏配置。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the screen recording configuration. If set to true, the configuration is updated if it exists or created if it does not exist. If set to false, the screen recording configuration for the corresponding instance is disabled.

description.zh:
过期天数。
默认值：7。><notice> 仅当设置了RecordStorageTarget时有效。 ></notice>
description.en:
The number of days before expiration.
Default value: 7.><notice> This parameter takes effect only when RecordStorageTarget is specified. ></notice>.

description.zh:
录屏存储目标地址。取值：
录屏存储的目标地址为 OSS ，格式为acs:oss:{RegionId}:{ResourceOwnerId}:{BucketName}/{PathName}。
ResourceOwnerId为OSS Bucket归属的主账号ID。
注意：
用户自己创建的OSS Bucket的BucketName需符合命名格式：workbench-record-[账号ID]-[自定义字符串]。
description.en:
The storage destination for screen recordings. Valid values:

The storage destination is OSS, in the format of acs:oss:{RegionId}:{ResourceOwnerId}:{BucketName}/{PathName}.
ResourceOwnerId is the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the OSS bucket belongs.
Note:
The BucketName of a user-created OSS bucket must follow this naming format: workbench-record-[AccountID]-[CustomString].
The region where the service is located.
The region where the instance resides.
